title: Evidence record, schema version 2
description: One evidence record as the Compliance Policy Engine issues it (schema_version 2). The canonical body is every member except record_hash, issuer_signature and chain_hash, serialised with RFC 8785. Fields a ledger stamps beside the record (submitter_msp, submitter_id) are not part of the record.

evidence_id.description: Identity. Opaque UUID of the record.

scenario_id.description: Identity. Label chosen by the integrator; free text, removed in redacted exports.

event_type.description: Identity. Type of the pipeline event.

artifact_id.description: Identity. Name of the artefact the event concerns; free text, removed in redacted exports.

artifact_type.description: Identity. Declared type of the artefact (dataset, model, report, ...).

pipeline_stage.description: Identity. Stage of the pipeline that emitted the event.

timestamp.description: Identity. Time the engine recorded the event (ISO 8601 with offset).

run_id.description: Identity. Execution or release the event belongs to; null when the event has none.

payload_hash.description: Content commitment. SHA-256 of the event as the engine received it, after pseudonymisation.

artifact_hash.description: Content commitment. SHA-256 of the artefact file; null when the event carries no artefact.

off_chain_ref.description: Content commitment. Path of the artefact in the content-addressed store.

reason.description: Decision. Human-readable reason; removed in redacted exports.

rule_id.description: Decision. The rule that decided, from a closed vocabulary of ten.

metrics.description: Decision. Metrics the event reported; null when it reported none.

decision_inputs.description: Decision. What the decision read beyond the metrics, kept so that it can be re-executed.

anyOf.description: A signed approval, kept whole so that a third party can verify it.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 form of the statement, base64.

policy_id.description: Decision. pol- followed by the first twelve characters of policy_hash.

policy_hash.description: Decision. SHA-256 of the canonical content of the archived policy.

supports_requirements.description: Normative binding. Provisions whose assessment the record supports; never a verdict.

issuer_id.description: Provenance. Identifier of the issuing engine.

issuer_pubkey_fingerprint.description: Provenance. SHA-256 fingerprint of the issuer's Ed25519 public key.

schema_version.description: Provenance. Version of the evidence model; selects the canonical form.

parent_hash.description: Chain. chain_hash of the previous record; 64 zeros for the first.

record_hash.description: Chain. SHA-256 of the canonical body.

issuer_signature.description: Chain. Ed25519 signature over the canonical body, base64.
